naslov: Elephant-Goldfish Model: Google's spec review plugin for Claude Code | AI Tool #10
opis:
Google's open-source plugin that makes an agent write a spec, then has several "fresh" subagents review it before any code is written. Works in Claude Code.

How to try it:
1. Make sure you have Claude Code 2.1.271 or newer (claude --version).
2. Open the plugin's GitHub repo from the link and install it following the README (check the exact commands there).
3. Try it on a small feature in an Angular/Supabase project and watch your usage limits, since it burns a lot of tokens.

Price: free (uses your existing model limits)

Official link: https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/08/google-elephant-goldfish-model-plugin-spec-review-coding-agents/

naslov: Astryx by Meta: React design system with a CLI for AI agents | AI Tool #11
opis:
An open-source React design system with a CLI that agents read component docs from.

How to try it:
1. In a React 19 project, run: npm install @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex
2. Add the CLI: npm install -D @astryxdesign/cli (or globally: npm i -g @astryxdesign/cli)
3. Run npx astryx component --list and tell Claude Code to build screens using Astryx components.

Price: free (MIT)

Official link: https://github.com/meta/astryx

naslov: What is an AI benchmark? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
An AI benchmark is a standardized test: the same set of tasks for every model, so their scores can be compared. Alibaba and several Asian universities built Co-Design Bench from real web app change requests that users had to rephrase or send back. The top model, GPT-6 Astra, fully solved only 26.4% of the tasks, even though models score above 99% on older benchmarks.
